title: Qlik Cloud Failures by App
dataSources: Qlik Cloud audit (`qlik:cloud:audit`) and REST API.
app: Qlik Cloud audit events and the Qlik Cloud REST API via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:cloud:audit action="reload.failed"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by app_id
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Qlik Cloud failures grouped by app so operators immediately see which specific apps are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Qlik Cloud is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Qlik Cloud failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical apps.
visualization: Table of app by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Qlik Cloud are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
